purpose: Qualitative prompt-reference dataset; not model training or a live social feed.
sampling: Eight high-engagement video sources; 22 brief source excerpts and 24 original classroom adaptations. Public text/captures only; counts are snapshots. Commenter identities are omitted. German examples are authored, not comment translations.
limitations: Instagram examples overrepresent one school-sketch creator. Some TikTok evidence is cached or secondary; the direct viewer required sign-in/age verification. Popularity does not prove a joke is funny.

examples.question: Wer möchte seine Antwort vorlesen?
examples.reply: Ich lese vor. Wenn meine Antwort genauso lang sein soll wie Ihre Frage, brauche ich aber erst noch einen verdammten Zettel und eine Pause.
examples.english: I will read it out. But if my answer needs to be as long as your question, I will need a damn sheet of paper and a break first.

examples.english: I am late, yes. I understood the reminder the first time. Talking about it for another five minutes will not save any damn time either.
